name: GAN V100 3x3 Leap (Magnetic, Core Magnets)
description: The GAN V100 3x3 Leap is a light, fully tunable 55 mm speed cube built on GAN's V100 platform. Piece magnets give each turn a crisp click and a core-magnet system pulls layers into alignment for added stability, while a ~62 g build keeps it quick and easy on the hands. With 72 tuning configurations, you set the feel rather than settle for it.
features: Crisp, accurate turning: piece magnets give every layer a defined click, so turns land where you mean them to.
Stable at speed: the core-magnet system pulls layers into alignment and steadies the cube through fast solves, with fewer lockups.
Light and quick: at ~62 g it moves with little effort and stays comfortable across long practice sessions.
Tune it to your hands: 72 configurations let you set the feel from soft and fast to firm and controlled, with no guesswork.
72 configurations: combine 6 levels of center-piece travel with 12 tension settings to land on the exact feel you want.
Two independent axes: adjust how loose and fast versus firm and controlled the cube turns without endless trial and error.
